claims: C1 the example illustrates a malicious instruction delivered through tool output
C2 such a tool-output instruction may try to get the user to visit a malicious website
C3 such a tool-output instruction may instead be a more complex instruction that coaxes the assistant into leaking user information

concepts.name: malicious_instruction_from_tool_output
concepts.gloss: I is an instruction that reaches the assistant through tool output and is malicious in intent

concepts.name: tool_output_instruction
concepts.gloss: I is an instruction contained in the output of a tool, as opposed to a user message

concepts.name: coaxes_user_to_visit_malicious_site
concepts.gloss: I is an instruction that tries to get the user to visit a malicious website

concepts.name: coaxes_assistant_to_leak_user_info
concepts.gloss: I is a more complex instruction that coaxes the assistant into leaking user information

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: the rule carries root authority: it is a top-level rule of the #ignore_untrusted_data section
